g.text: ① The window that chooses — renderer process
②③ Main process — validate the folder, then serve the new window
④⑤ The NEW window — renderer process

p.em: They are not the app's own colours.
Numbers are the five legs of the flow.

div.p:
Picker
"Choose folder..." or a recent row.
Sends an absolute path and
nothing else

Bootstrap (on refusal)
marker checklist · markerAdvice
· "Start <agent> here" · "Check again"
The app never writes the schema

chooseDirectory
native openDirectory dialog,
"Choose a project with an llmwiki
block in its CLAUDE.md"

openProjectInput
must be absolute, 1..4096 chars.
Anything else is bad-request
and nothing happens

loadProject
stat the dir, then CLAUDE.md, then
AGENTS.md. First file whose block
parses wins

parseClaudeBlock (core)
fenced code blanked first, then
Wiki root: Journal: Kind:.
safeRoot rejects / ~ .. and the root

projectStore.remember
upsert into projects.json with a hue
hashed from the path.
Queued, temp-then-rename

openWindow
createWindow() then
registry.attach(id, project) —
attached BEFORE the renderer loads

project:current -> snapshot
name and hue from the store,
layout, and a fresh file list.
Window identity from the IPC sender

listWikiFiles
one recursive readdir over the wiki
root and the journal + stat the agent
files. Dot paths dropped, sorted

file:read -> readWikiFile
readFileInput guard, then locate,
realpath, containment, 2 MB cap.
One round trip per listed path

createApi
chooseProject · openProject(dir) · listProjects
currentProject() · readFile(path) · onProjectEvent
casts every reply, validates nothing

CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md
the only place a layout may
be declared

the wiki root tree
00_state · NN_notes · registers
· archive/

the journal tree
YYYY-MM-DD_slug.md

projects.json
in userData: dir, hue,
last opened

App.Window
currentProject() resource.
undefined -> show the Picker.
Sets --project-hue on the document

createNoteStore + parseNote
reads EVERY listed path, one ticket
per path so stale replies are dropped.
Budget refusal -> shown as plain text

buildNavigation / classify
five sections in schema order; notes
by number, registers by schema order,
journal newest first

Sidebar + DebtSection
status dot, cap gauge, contentions
badge. StatusBar and the CmdK
Palette read the same list

g.text: ProjectSnapshot { dir, name, hue, layout, files }
{ text, sha, mtime } | outside-project | not-found | too-large | unreadable
⑤ chokidar, one watcher per dir: change -> {file, path}, else coalesced {files} -> project:event to every window on the dir
